label: Round-trip cycle
description: A closed loop: the money returns to the account it started from, having passed through others. In a laundering context the loop exists to produce an apparent provenance for funds that already belonged to the originator.
confounders: Settlement between related businesses, which is cyclical by design and entirely routine.
A reversal or refund that happens to route back through an intermediary.
Two people repaying each other in alternation — a shared household, or a rotating savings group.
notes: A cycle is easy to detect and easy to produce innocently, so the detection is worth little without the explanation. The useful form is a cycle plus a short holding time at each hop plus near-complete throughput; the cycle alone should raise a lead and not a conclusion.
